name: Master of Death

abilities.text: At the beginning of your upkeep, if ~ is in your graveyard, you may pay 1 life. If you do, return it to your hand.

notes: 'You may pay 1 life. If you do, return it to your hand' is one may over both halves: paying 1 life is written as losing 1 life (no AbilityCost is available inside an effect list), and the two are inseparable, so the payment can never happen without the return.

issues: At the beginning of your upkeep, if this card is in your graveyard, you may pay 1 life. If you do, return it to your hand. — expected the ability functions from the graveyard and triggers each of your upkeeps while the card is there — scripted the trigger is written correctly (intervening self-in-graveyard), but queueTriggers only scans triggerPerms() = allPermanents(s) plus command-zone hooks (src/engine/game.ts ~2148) — graveyard cards are never scanned, so this ability can never fire. Sandbox records ability index 1 reached:false, and the blind scenario failed: Master of Death stayed in graveyard, life 20 !== 19, hand 0 !== 1 — CR CR 603.6 / 603.10 — abilities that function from the graveyard trigger from that zone

you may pay 1 life — expected paying life is a cost payment, not a life-loss event — scripted op 'lose-life' amount 1 — will trigger 'whenever you lose life' watchers and interacts with loss-prevention effects that a payment would not — CR CR 118.8 / 119.3 — paying life is not losing life for triggers that care
